title: PBC IL12RB2-TYK2 reproducibility repository
description: Reproducibility code, compact derived data, figure-generation scripts, and audit records supporting a multi-cohort translational genomics study that prioritizes the IL12RB2-TYK2 axis for therapeutic testing in primary biliary cholangitis.
